independence: The unchanged pinned original scorer performs its own forward. No canonical logits or derived canonical NLLs are fed into the oracle.
technical_preconditions: Existing locked native FP32/eager/TF32-off model and tokenizer/runtime
Exact same weight/state identity and ordered cohort in both results
Native tokenizer right padding; actual BOS behavior checked, no fake model-name or BOS adaptation
No-grad/eval/cache setting recorded and model/tokenizer/RNG/state restored
No fit/edit/context generation or added scientific arm

tolerances.reason: New fixed technical comparison tolerances for native FP32 operation/batch grouping, declared before actual runs. Neither paper reproduction 1pp nor generation KV tolerances are reused.

pre_execution_smoke.cohort: Own locked CF ordered occurrences 1,2,3,4 (first four, no result-based selection)
pre_execution_smoke.state: Existing authorized W0/native qualification loaded state
pre_execution_smoke.canonical: Reuse same-state exact canonical raw when identity/token/cohort is certified; otherwise record a small canonical observation in the already-authorized qualification, not a new fit.
pre_execution_smoke.oracle: One independent original factual candidate batch per case; no generation
pre_execution_smoke.admission_meaning: Satisfies real engineering evaluator smoke only when actually run and passed; source/CPU/passive same-call controls alone do not. An actual successful preregistered same-model first300 B3 matched comparison includes these first4 and can satisfy that engineering admission without a redundant first4 forward; retain its ACTUAL_MATCHED_SUBSET evidence label.

existing_B3_comparison.cohort: Existing same-state first300 canonical raw, ordered occurrences1..300, fixed before native comparison
existing_B3_comparison.state: SAME locked actual qualification B3 weights, not W0 or another edited branch
existing_B3_comparison.comparison: Independent pinned native scorer at that same state with the same fixed tolerances and strict identity/boolean/count gates
existing_B3_comparison.canonical_raw: Reuse original provenance intact if exact identity/token/state validation succeeds; do not relabel or silently synthesize a reference.
existing_B3_comparison.engineering_admission_if_actual_passed: Accepted stronger same-model original-vs-common engineering evidence; no duplicate smaller smoke solely to change the evidence label.

full_2k_requirement.state: Actual authorized full-2k endpoint weights, preferably W20 with canonical W20 raw reused at identical state
full_2k_requirement.meaning: README's full Llama AlphaEdit 2k comparison remains a separate completion evidence item. Small smoke does not clear it; do not create a circular requirement for completed W20 before starting an authorized chain.

passive_same_call_formula_guard: Keep as a separately labeled owner-formula control, never original independent parity.
checkpoint_resume: Separate B3 versus B2-resume proof remains required; oracle parity does not replace it.
reporting: Keep CPU_FIXTURE_PASS, ACTUAL_GPU_SMOKE, ACTUAL_FULL_2K and actual work/calls/time/source/state/cohort separately. Raw tokens/text/IDs remain local; Git/W&B compact scalar-only.
job_changes: No old job mutations or new scientific chains; owners connect the shared source to existing approved qualification and main tasks.
